findings.message: Camunda 8 does not write the caught code or message into "code".
findings.suggestion: Have the thrower pass the values as variables and map them with an output mapping on the catch event.

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.8.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.

xml:

  <bpmn:process id="p" isExecutable="true">

      <bpmn:errorEventDefinition camunda:errorCodeVariable="code"/>

  </bpmn:process>
